summary: First full test of TapID (backend + Expo web preview at 375x667). Backend: 38/38 pytest pass (20 existing + 18 new tests against the public URL) covering auth, RBAC 401/403, 422 validation, issuance rules (needs active enrollment, only one active credential), replay_detected, credential_revoked, not_enrolled, no_permission, invalid_token, the reader /api/verify X-Reader-Key check, the admin reader simulate/verify, log filters, student search/filter, analytics, photo upload and download (object storage works, owner 200 / other student 403 / anonymous 401), and building duplicate checks. Frontend: every requested flow works end to end: demo login, ID card, tap LIB granted / SCI denied, QR sheet with countdown, History, Profile, lost-device revoke, register -> pending card, admin overview charts, students search and filters, student detail (enrollment chips, issue, revoke, permission switches + save), Reader simulate + replay blocked, Logs filters and search, Buildings add sheet with duplicate error, photo upload through the web file chooser. One bug found and fixed: duplicate React key in the overview daily chart, which raised a LogBox console error that covered the admin tab bar. One deprecated import found: expo-router/unstable-native-tabs. No other deprecated packages (expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch) are used. The demo student student@tapid.edu still has active credential TID-5588BD245CE6 and access to LIB/ENG/REC.

minor.issue: The session JWT is accepted as a query parameter (get_principal_header_or_query). This leaks the long-lived session token into URLs, proxy logs and caches. Consider short-lived signed photo URLs or a separate photo token.
Loads up to 50k log docs into memory and groups them in Python. Use a Mongo $group aggregation. 'Today' uses UTC day boundaries, not campus local time.
The granted message is 'Access granted', the same as the result title, so the UI shows 'Access granted / Access granted'. Use a more useful message, e.g. 'Welcome - door unlocked'.
There is no delete or edit endpoint for buildings or students. Admins cannot fix typos, and test data cannot be cleaned up.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: key={d.label} used narrow weekday labels (S,S,T,T), which raised a duplicate-key console error. On web the LogBox error toast covered the admin tab bar and blocked taps on tabs. Changed the key to index+label.

issues: At 375px the credential UID (TID-XXXXXXXXXXXX) overflows the card's inner padding to the card edge. Fix: flexShrink + numberOfLines/adjustsFontSizeToFit, or put the meta row on two lines. Ref: src/components/digital-id-card.tsx:74
The 'Tap another door' secondary button label wraps onto two lines and is left-aligned. Shorten the label or center it with a single line.
The header email wraps mid-word ('...@tapid.ed' / 'u'). The Active badge squeezes the name column. Consider putting the badge under the name, and numberOfLines=1 with ellipsizeMode on the email.
Chip height is about 36px, below the 44pt touch-target minimum.
The enrollment badge is left-aligned while the rest of the profile card is centered.
revoke-credential-button revokes on a single tap with no confirmation. The student-side revoke has a confirm sheet; add the same for admin.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated import. The console warns: '`expo-router/unstable-native-tabs` is deprecated. Use `expo-router/native-tabs` instead.' Reference: /app/frontend/app/student/_layout.tsx:2 and /app/frontend/app/admin/_layout.tsx:2

action_items: Change the NativeTabs import from 'expo-router/unstable-native-tabs' to 'expo-router/native-tabs' in app/student/_layout.tsx and app/admin/_layout.tsx.
Fix the credential UID overflow on the digital ID card at 375px width.
Add a confirmation sheet before the admin revokes a credential (revoke-credential-button).
Raise chip touch targets to at least 44pt (minHeight 44 or hitSlop).
Improve the 'granted' reason message so it does not repeat the title; fix the 'Tap another door' button wrapping.
Overview recent-denied rows reuse the log-row-{id} testIDs from the Logs tab. Give them a different prefix (e.g. overview-log-row-) to avoid duplicate testIDs.
Reader building chips use Mongo ids in testIDs (reader-building-<id>). Use the building code for consistency (reader-building-LIB).

tests/test_api_integration.py creates students named 'Test Student' (no TEST_ prefix) with active credentials and never cleans up. They now fill the admin pending list (12 pending) and the reader credential list. Prefix with TEST_ and add cleanup, or a delete endpoint.
Optional: replace session-token-in-query for photos with signed short-lived URLs; move analytics to a Mongo aggregation.
critical_code_review_comments: The verification pipeline is solid: nonce single-use through a unique-index insert, a domain-separated tap-token key, every attempt logged, and the cross-student token is rejected with 403 on /api/me/simulated-tap.
The nonce is consumed before the building check, so a tap at a wrong or missing building burns the token. This is acceptable, but worth documenting.
Students and logs lists have no pagination (limit 100/200).
CORS allow_origins=['*'] is fine for preview but should be restricted for production.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows functional after the chart key fix; design issues listed

seed_data_creation: Created and could not delete (no delete endpoints): API-test students 'TEST_ Student <sfx>' (test_<sfx>@tapid.edu, 2 runs, credentials revoked); UI student 'TEST_ UI 08ea8d' (test_ui_08ea8d@tapid.edu / Password!1, active enrollment, credentials revoked, LIB permission, photo uploaded); building 'TEST_ Hall TS460' (code TS460); plus verification log entries. Demo data was not modified apart from new access-log entries for student@tapid.edu (taps at LIB/SCI and an admin reader simulate/replay).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the backend with: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests -q (pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope; for serial runs use -n 0, not -p no:xdist). The public URL comes from frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (there is no EXPO_BACKEND_URL key). On web the tab testIDs are tab-student-id/history/profile and tab-admin-overview/students/reader/logs. Photo upload works on web through page.expect_file_chooser on change-photo-button. Overview recent-denied rows share the log-row- prefix, so count log rows only within logs-list.
rca_of_issue: Admin overview console error 'Encountered two children with the same key, T': StackedBars used the narrow weekday label as the React key, and 7 days contain repeated letters (S/S, T/T). Fixed by keying on index+label. Verified: no console errors on the overview, and the admin tab bar is no longer covered by the LogBox toast.
